steps.text: Open the member's "Documents" tab. You can review existing documents and add new ones.
steps.title: Documents tab

steps.text: Click "Add document" to open the upload dialog.
steps.title: Add a document

steps.text: Select the file to upload from your computer (or drag it into the drop zone).
steps.title: Choose the file

steps.text: Click "Upload": the document is saved and attached to the member.
steps.title: Upload

steps.text: The document "e2e-document.pdf" now appears in the member's document list.
steps.title: Document added

title: Upload a document to a member
